description: Electric vehicle chargepoints operated by Leeds City Council. is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Data Mill North. Usage data for Electric Vehicle chargepoints in Council car parks in Leeds including how often they are used, duration of charge, electricity consumed and type of vehicle. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Data Mill North. It offers 16 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
